title: OnlySpawn
description: Spawn all players at a specific coordinate when they join the server.
body:
This plugin has only one function:

Teleport all players to a designated location when they join the server.

In simple terms: Fixed spawn point.



这个插件只有一个功能

玩家进服时将玩家(所有)传送到指定的地点

人话：固定出生点



Features:

1. Supports Folia

And that's it, no other features.



特点：

1.支持Folia

然后就没有其它特点了



Commands:


/os help - Help


/os setspawn - Set global spawn point

/os reload - Reload JSON configuration

/os info - Current spawn point information



指令：


/os help 帮助


/os setspawn 设置全局出生点

/os reload 重载json配置

/os info 目前出生点信息
